factors.comparison: one request at a time over the highest load reached
factors.tell: the dominant lever on every model and all three GPUs

factors.comparison: fresh request over one with 16k tokens already cached
factors.tell: large for long reused prompts, small (median 7%) at 1k

factors.comparison: past the limit over just below it on the same pod (Llama-3.3-70B, one B200)
factors.tell: a cliff, not a slope: admission limits and memory headroom reduce the risk, but the safe point depends on the workload and the scheduler

factors.comparison: longest context up to 32k whose runs kept their cache over 1k, design batch 64; long context forced a smaller batch on some servers; configurations marked ‘runs differ’ in Table 14 left out
factors.tell: rises with context and more steeply at deep batch, where the stored context fills memory

factors.comparison: longest context up to 32k over 1k, design batch 8; configurations marked ‘runs differ’ in Table 14 left out
B200 over H100 on the same number of GPUs, at the same batch
factors.tell: no consistent saving: lower for some models, higher for others

factors.factor: H200 against H100, same GPU count
factors.comparison: H200 over H100 on the same number of GPUs, at the same batch
factors.tell: close to 1: the two share a design, and the H200 adds memory

factors.factor: One larger GPU against two H100s
factors.comparison: one B200 or one H200 over the two H100s Llama-3.3-70B needs, at the same batch; changes GPU type and GPU count together
factors.tell: a saving, part of it from holding the model on fewer GPUs
